quote: Excelerate has acquired the assets and operations of the Montego Bay liquified natural gas (“LNG”) Terminal, the Old Harbour LNG Terminal, and the Clarendon combined heat and power plant.
note: Opened Excelerate 14 May 2025 close release for assets; USD 1.055bn cash price from companion 27 Mar 2025 definitive-agreement release (excelerate_jamaica_deal_20250327).
